_comment: DRAFT entry for the official MCP Registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io). Before publishing: (1) verify against the CURRENT registry schema — it evolves; (2) the `name` namespace must match a domain/repo you can prove ownership of (io.github.clarilayer/* via the GitHub repo, or com.clarilayer/* via DNS TXT verification). Publish with the `mcp-publisher` CLI.
name: io.github.clarilayer/clarilayer
description: Individual-analyst context layer over MCP. Bootstraps your working data context from SQL/dbt, reconciles definitions against your warehouse (caveat on mismatch), and remembers corrections so your agent stops re-explaining your data.
